title: "Vertical Hue" Wins First Prize in the Professional Category
description: In the final round of the Genesis Green Living Challenge 2026 social housing design competition, MVN Group earned First Prize in the Professional category for its "Vertical Hue" proposal.
content:
In the final round of the Genesis Green Living Challenge 2026 social housing design competition, MVN Group earned First Prize in the Professional category for its "Vertical Hue" proposal.

Inspired by Hue's traditional garden houses and distinctive community lifestyle, "Vertical Hue" offers a sustainable social housing solution that optimizes the microclimate and meets green building standards. The jury praised the proposal for its feasibility, operational efficiency, and ability to preserve local identity within a contemporary urban environment.

The award recognizes MVN Group's professional expertise, creative thinking, and commitment to advancing green architecture in social housing.
